The scene includes red syrup simulating blood and white/red candy pieces resembling brains or gore scattered on the plate. The background is a dark, textured black fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The point where the metal blade enters the fondant/cake lacks realistic displacement or compression. The cake material does not deform or crack realistically around the entry point, appearing slightly fused or 'melted' into the metal rather than being cut.
The red liquid has a slightly uniform, plastic-like viscosity that doesn't fully adhere to the physics of real syrup or blood, though this may be due to the use of candy/gel decorations.
The transition from the blade to the handle (bolster) seems slightly warped, lacking the sharp, machined lines expected of a real steel tool, possibly due to AI smoothing.
